description.value: Asfendiyarov Kazakh National Medical University is a long-standing Almaty medical university with bachelor programs in medicine, public health, pharmacy, nursing and related healthcare fields. Official applicant pages describe UNT thresholds for healthcare, psychometric examination and enrollment stages.

description.value: Abai Kazakh National Pedagogical University is Kazakhstan's first higher education institution and a major pedagogical university in Almaty. Official materials and QS profile describe broad teacher-training, humanities, social-science and informatics programs across multiple faculties.
description.method: Summary derived from official university bachelor, applicant, or institutional pages.
